people.name: Dev
observations: Came over and used Coda for real for the first time
Practiced with the bass for forty minutes in Jordan's living room
Marked eleven moments during their session, each a place where something went wrong
Said 'this is my list for tomorrow' about the marked moments
Has a gig on the 19th with a setlist and a bandleader
Practices toward a deadline, treating practice as triage
Said 'oh - I do that same run every time I don't know what to play' at mark six
Discovered a years-old crutch within ninety seconds of reviewing their data
Played the moment marked as the worst one straight through four times until it improved

people.name: Pepper
observations: Left the room at the high slapped notes during Dev's practice
Came back at the end, as if making her position clear

projects.name: Coda
observations: Jordan built the app and has been running personal sessions through free play for nine days
Jordan sideloaded the build onto Dev's phone for their first real use
The marker button was originally a small 44pt button, changed to a full-width strip by day three
Has an auto-stop at 90 minutes, added after it killed a session once
Review screen labels marked moments as 'highlights' with a header saying 'your best moments'
Export feature is called a 'highlight reel'
Dev used the highlight feature as a bug tracker instead of a trophy case
Jordan realized the app never modeled a person who practices toward a deadline versus for emotional reasons
Jordan is considering a fix where marks stay neutral until labeled during the review step
